[[Tembisa Classic]] | prevseason = [[2000–01 South African Premiership|2000–01]] | nextseason = [[2002–03 Premier Soccer League|2002–03]] }} The '''2001–02 South African Premiership''', known as the 2001–02 '''Castle Premiership''' for sponsorship purposes, and also commonly referred to as the [[Premier Soccer League|PSL]] after the governing body, was the sixth season of the [[South African Premiership|Premiership]] since its establishment in 1996. [[Santos F.C. (South Africa)|Santos]] surprisingly won the title under the mentorship of [[Gordon Igesund]]. This side featured players like [[Edries Burton]], [[Andre Arendse]], [[Musa Otieno]] and the club's all-time top goalscorer [[Jean-Marc Ithier]]. With the title win Santos became the first – and to date the only – team that was not a founder-member of the Premiership to win the league.{{Cite web|url=https://www.iol.co.za/capeargus/sport/its-official-santos-are-psl-champs-509971|title=It's official - Santos are PSL champs|accessdate=17 July 2023}}{{Cite web |last= |title=From Manning Rangers to Sundowns — all the PSL winners in 25 years |url=https://www.timeslive.co.za/sport/soccer/2021-06-12-from-manning-rangers-to-sundowns-all-the-psl-winners-in-25-years/ |access-date=2024-01-01 |website=TimesLIVE |language=en-ZA}}{{Cite web |title=It's official - Santos are PSL champs |url=https://www.iol.co.za/capeargus/sport/its-official-santos-are-psl-champs-509971 |access-date=2024-12-31 |website=www.iol.co.za |language=en}} ==Final table== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=QR |team1=SAN|name_SAN=[[Santos F.C.
